question: Can you calculate the median from the highest season goals of each team?
sql:
-- Verify: count teams and show some stats about the highest season goals
WITH team_season_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        t.team_long_name,
        m.season,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id THEN m.home_team_goal 
                WHEN m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id THEN m.away_team_goal 
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ) AS total_goals
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id IN (m.home_team_api_id, m.away_team_api_id)
    WHERE m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id OR m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    GROUP BY t.team_long_name, m.season
),
highest_season_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        team_long_name,
        MAX(total_goals) AS highest_goals
    FROM team_season_goals
    GROUP BY team_long_name
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS num_teams,
    MIN(highest_goals) AS min_highest,
    MAX(highest_goals) AS max_highest,
    AVG(highest_goals) AS avg_highest,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY highest_goals) AS median_highest_season_goals
FROM highest_season_goals
